roadmap.title: First story and ongoing counters
roadmap.description: Play on Easy or Normal. Loot human bodies throughout the story, use crafted melee weapons, and take stealth kills. Advance the story to open all regions.

roadmap.title: Explore and prepare for New Game+
roadmap.description: Finish camp jobs and regional activities. Collect 181 entries, improve camp trust, and buy useful weapons and bike upgrades before starting New Game+.

roadmap.title: Survival II New Game+
roadmap.description: Use the completed story save to start Survival II New Game+. Get the BND-150 ammo kills and a fast Horde kill, then finish the story.

roadmap.title: Challenges
roadmap.description: Build up Bronze patches and Ring upgrades, then earn Gold in every main Challenge and medals in all 48 Sub-Challenges.

roadmap.title: Horde Assault
roadmap.description: Clear the four map targets and build Horde Assault XP to Level 35.

roadmap.title: Permadeath and completion
roadmap.description: For the recommended third run, choose Permadeath on Easy with Per Act selected. A first run in Permadeath can reduce the minimum to two playthroughs. Finish the remaining achievements for One Percenter.

achievements.description: Go above and BEYOND, unlocking every trophy in Days Gone

steps.text: Finish every other achievement, including the extra game modes and Broken Road achievements. Relaunch the game if One Percenter does not appear after the final unlock.

achievements.description: Defeat your first Horde
achievements.summary: Wipe out one entire Horde.

steps.text: Defeat a Horde completely; the main story includes a required Horde battle at Chemult. Use explosives on clustered Freakers, then finish survivors with an automatic weapon.

achievements.description: Accumulate 10 minutes of drifting while on your bike
achievements.summary: Build up 10 minutes of bike drifting.

steps.text: Drift in circles beside the fuel supply at O’Leary Mountain Safehouse. Refuel as needed until the cumulative drifting time reaches 10 minutes.

achievements.description: Kill a Breaker, Reacher, or Rager with the boot knife.
achievements.summary: Deliver the killing blow to a Breaker, Reacher, or Rager using the boot knife.

steps.text: During Playing All Night, shoot the Breaker until its health is low, then finish it with the boot knife. If you kill it with a gun, use a later free-roaming Breaker, Reacher, or Rager.

achievements.description: Get 100 stealth kills
achievements.summary: Perform 100 stealth takedowns.

steps.text: Approach unaware humans or Freakers from behind and use the takedown prompt. Throw rocks to turn enemies away from you.

achievements.description: Kill 200 Enemies with a Crafted Weapon
achievements.summary: Kill 200 enemies using crafted weapons.

steps.text: Craft a Spiked Bat after the early ambush-camp tutorial and use it against isolated enemies. Learn Field Repairs to repair crafted melee weapons with scrap.

achievements.displayName: Variety is the Spice of Life

achievements.description: Upgrade your bike for the first time
achievements.summary: Buy your first bike upgrade.

steps.text: Purchase a bike part from an encampment mechanic.

achievements.description: Use nitro and drift at the same time on your bike for at least 5 seconds
achievements.summary: Drift the bike while using nitro continuously for at least five seconds.

steps.text: Reach Trust Level 3 at Diamond Lake and buy Nitrous III from its mechanic.
Equip Standard Tires. Start a wide circular drift, then hold nitro while keeping the bike sliding for at least five seconds.

achievements.description: Apply 100 scrap to your bike
achievements.summary: Use 100 scrap to repair the bike.

steps.text: Collect scrap from vehicles and use it to repair bike damage yourself. Mechanic repair payments do not spend your scrap.

achievements.description: Collect 541 Items from corpses
achievements.summary: Loot 541 items from human corpses.

guide.context: Checking a body while your inventory is full adds no progress.

steps.text: Search human enemies after fights and take their items. Use or craft supplies to make inventory space before looting.

achievements.description: Collect 989 Freaker Ears
achievements.summary: Gather 989 Freaker ears.

steps.text: Walk over killed Freakers to pick up their ears. Sell ears to camp bounty collectors as needed; sold ears still count toward the total.

steps.text: Investigate blue question marks and rescue captives or people threatened by enemies. Speak to each rescued survivor to send them to a camp.

achievements.summary: Reach Allied Trust with three different encampments.

steps.text: Raise Iron Mike’s, Diamond Lake, and Wizard Island to Trust Level 3. Complete their jobs and nearby Hordes, then hand in ears and food to whichever camp still needs trust.

collectibles.name: Surrounded
collectibles.location: Main menu: Challenges, then select Surrounded.
collectibles.method: Take the Chicago Chopper from the gift shop’s upstairs table by the fire exit and the SMP9 from the gas-station counter. Keep kills close together to build a score chain, and use Attractors with explosives on crowds.

collectibles.name: Keep Them Safer
collectibles.location: Main menu: Challenges, then select Keep Them Safer.
collectibles.method: Fire crossbow bolts from behind your starting bike before alerting the Horde. Use explosives next, then retreat and shoot with Focus. Avoid damage and dodge rolls to protect the relevant Sub-Challenge bonuses.

collectibles.location: Main menu: Challenges, then select Infested.
collectibles.method: Fight inside active zones and keep the kill chain going. Equip Bullets and 1%er Rings to help sustain the run.

collectibles.name: Reload
collectibles.location: Main menu: Challenges, then select Reload.
collectibles.method: Equip Bullets and Lionheart Rings. Keep kills close together to build the chain. Shoot Freakers while Focus is active, and lure groups across the wooden bridges between roofs or vehicles so the bridges collapse for environmental kills.

collectibles.name: Dead Before Daylight
collectibles.location: Main menu: Challenges, then select Dead Before Daylight.
collectibles.method: Complete the four Sub-Challenge objectives while building the main score. Preserve your chain between groups of Freakers.

collectibles.location: Main menu: Challenges, then select Black Friday.
collectibles.method: Equip Bullets and Ram Rings. Build the Growler’s score chain beyond 300 and keep firing into grouped Freakers to maintain it.

collectibles.name: Survive
collectibles.location: Main menu: Challenges, then select Survive.
collectibles.method: Stealth-kill the first enemies, then work toward 50 headshots. Loot stronger weapons between waves and use melee against armored enemies to conserve ammunition.

collectibles.name: Ambush Camp Rush
collectibles.location: Main menu: Challenges, then select Ambush Camp Rush.
collectibles.method: Aim to finish within 3:30 and score at least 15,000. Kill and loot rapidly to keep the chain above 50; use Residue Bolts and crafted explosives for Sub-Challenge points.

collectibles.name: Drifter’s Run
collectibles.location: Main menu: Challenges, then select Drifter’s Run.
collectibles.method: Maintain a score chain through drifts, sidearm kills, and jumps. Aim for a finish under 2:35 and use the ramps for airtime bonuses.

collectibles.name: Dead Don’t Ride
collectibles.location: Main menu: Challenges, then select Dead Don’t Ride.
collectibles.method: Drift while collecting and dropping off passengers. Use nitro freely and choose yellow passenger routes when time is low; keep the cart away from deep water.

collectibles.name: Outride
collectibles.location: Main menu: Challenges, then select Outride.
collectibles.method: Keep a single score chain going through the race, aiming for 120. Shoot roadside Freakers with your sidearm so impacts do not slow the bike.

collectibles.name: Hog Wild
collectibles.location: Main menu: Challenges, then select Hog Wild.
collectibles.method: Keep accelerating throughout the run. Use the handbrake to drift, shoot Freakers as you pass, and take jumps to earn Sub-Challenge points.

achievements.description: Earn a Medal in all Sub-Challenges
achievements.summary: Win Bronze or better medals across all 48 Sub-Challenges.

steps.text: Each main Challenge has four Sub-Challenges. Check their objectives and earn a medal in every one; use separate attempts for objectives that conflict.

achievements.description: Spend 3000 credits on your Loadout
achievements.summary: Spend 3,000 Challenge credits on loadout purchases.

steps.text: Earn main and Sub-Challenge medals, then spend 3,000 credits on Rings, Ring upgrades, skins, and accents in the Challenge loadout.

achievements.description: Reach the Founder Rank
achievements.summary: Reach Founder Rank in Challenge mode.

steps.text: Earn medals across main Challenges and Sub-Challenges until your Challenge reputation reaches Level 6, requiring 90,000 XP.

achievements.description: Unlock all Patches
achievements.summary: Unlock all 12 Challenge patches.

steps.text: Finish every main Challenge with Bronze or better to receive its patch.

achievements.description: Complete the story of Days Gone in New Game+
achievements.summary: Complete the main story in New Game+.

steps.text: Finish an initial story run, keep its completed save, then select New Game+ with Survival II difficulty.
Complete the New Game+ story to unlock One More Ride, 2 Days 2 Done, and Surviving is Living together.

achievements.description: Complete the story of Days Gone on Hard II or Survival II in New Game+
achievements.summary: Complete New Game+ on Hard II or Survival II difficulty.

steps.text: Choose Survival II when starting New Game+ and finish the story. Keep your original completed save in a separate slot.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy with every type of ammo from a mysterious weapon earned in New Game+
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with each of the BND-150’s four ammunition types.

steps.text: In New Game+, take the BND-150 from the Special section of a gun locker.
Kill a human or Freaker with a regular round, X34 Gas Dart, EDT Dart, and Explosive Dart. Craft special darts using scrap plus Poison, a Spark Igniter, or Gun Powder respectively.

achievements.description: Wipe out an increased-size Horde during Horde Assault.
achievements.summary: Wipe out an increased-size Horde during Horde Assault.

steps.text: Survive in Horde Assault until a larger static Horde is available, then wipe it out. Use supply crates and side missions to replenish ammunition and throwables.

achievements.displayName: I'm On Top of the World
achievements.description: Beat the target score on every Horde Assault map.
achievements.summary: Beat the target score on every Horde Assault map.

steps.text: Meet the initial map targets: Cascade 400,000; Belknap 500,000; Lost Lake 750,000; Crater Lake 800,000. Each cleared target opens the next map.

achievements.description: Stay alive for 15 minutes in a single Horde Assault run.
achievements.summary: Stay alive for 15 minutes in a single Horde Assault run.

steps.text: Choose a Horde Assault map and survive until its timer reaches 15:00. Keep a route between buildings and ammunition boxes, and use Napalm Molotovs when Freakers bunch together.

achievements.description: Reach Level 35 in Horde Assault.
achievements.summary: Reach Level 35 in Horde Assault.

steps.text: Keep playing Horde Assault to earn XP toward Level 35. Complete side missions for ammunition and crafting supplies.
At Level 17, equip the Infinite Ammo Injector if you need help sustaining longer runs. Balance its score penalty with negative Injectors when working toward map targets.

achievements.description: Finish the main story in Permadeath mode on any difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish the main story in Permadeath mode on any difficulty.

steps.text: Choose New Game, then Permadeath, Easy, and Per Act. Permadeath starts a fresh campaign rather than New Game+.
Complete the main story. Save often and reload before a fatal situation; a death with Per Act selected returns you to the start of the current act.
Avoid bike jumps, steep drops, and deep water. Keep ammunition and healing supplies stocked.

achievements.description: Unlock Sarah’s Fuel Tank by reaching Reputation Phase 1 in Horde Assault.
achievements.summary: Unlock Sarah’s Fuel Tank by reaching Reputation Phase 1 in Horde Assault.

steps.text: Complete the first set of Horde Assault targets: 400,000 in Cascade, 500,000 in Belknap, 750,000 in Lost Lake, and 800,000 in Crater Lake. The Phase 1 reward is Sarah’s Fuel Tank.
